costume.name: Retro Astronaut
costume.description: A cream flight jumpsuit with burnt orange panels, silver accessories, and a rounded space helmet.
costume.alt: Rounded silver helmet with a dark visor, cream padded jumpsuit with burnt orange panels, utility belt, cream gloves, and silver boots

pieces.name: Rounded astronaut costume helmet
pieces.styleNotes: Use a rounded costume shell and visor. The silver option is closest; cheaper white shells change the color. These are decorative costume accessories.

matches.reason: One-piece plastic astronaut helmet with working shield visor, button and tubing details. White base with a rounded black visor dome; the shell is not silver. One size fits most; no head circumference given. Ships Monday–Friday from Chicago.

Two-piece plastic astronaut helmet. White shell with a clear visor and NASA decoration; differs from the silver shell and dark visor in the reference. Merchant states one size fits most adults and ages 14+. Ships Monday–Friday from Chicago.

Silver plastic astronaut helmet with NASA logo and flip-up blue translucent visor. Two pieces require assembly. Closest metallic shell option, but the blue visor and molded shape differ from the dark rounded reference. Helmet only; fits adults and larger teens.

pieces.name: Light flight jumpsuit base
pieces.styleNotes: Use a long-sleeve, full-length light jumpsuit. These bases are white, not cream, and lack the orange panels and padded quilting. Add the separate orange fabric component.

matches.reason: One white long-sleeve Red Kap CT10 coverall in cotton/polyester twill. A plain workwear base with zipper and pockets, without patches, orange panels or padding. Includes the white jumpsuit with embroidered patches. Product photo shows black straps and zipper accents. It is bright white rather than cream and has no burnt-orange panels or padded knees; add those from the separate fabric component. Helmet, gloves and footwear are separate.

Includes 100% polyester zip-up white jumpsuit with embroidered NASA patches and zipper pockets, plus embroidered baseball cap. The cap is extra and does not replace the helmet. White with black straps, not cream/orange; add separate fabric panels. Merchant offers US shipping; orders after 2pm Eastern miss that day’s cutoff.

pieces.name: Fabric utility-style belt
pieces.styleNotes: Use pale woven fabric and a visible buckle at the waist. These are plain belt approximations and do not include the reference pouches or shoulder suspenders.

matches.reason: Khaki washed-cotton belt with double-prong metal buckle and eyelets. More tan than the reference cream, and has no pouches or suspenders. Only the listed Khaki sizes at $17.99 are included.

Khaki / Standard width / Standard length only. Beige stretch webbing and matching plastic buckle approximate the cream waist strap. Merchant selector states 1.5-inch width and 24–38-inch waist range. No silver buckle, pouches or suspenders; this belt is not designed to carry gear.

pieces.name: Light full-finger gloves
pieces.styleNotes: Use full-finger cream or white gloves. Everyday cotton versions are thin; the costume gloves have long cuffs and black trim. None reproduce the reference padded channels.

pieces.name: Silver boots
pieces.styleNotes: Use metallic silver boots. The reference has flat, rounded, knee-high space boots; these available fashion boots change the heel, toe shape or shaft height.

matches.reason: Silver stretch vegan-leather knee-high go-go boots with 3-inch block heel and side zipper. Smoother and slimmer than the reference, without ribbed padding. Sizes use Women’s US labels; size 8 is sold out and omitted.

100% leather silver pointed-toe ankle boots with black lightning bolts, stud outlines and a low stacked heel. Much shorter and more decorative than the reference knee-high space boots. EU sizes 36, 37, 38, 39 and 41 are available; 40 is sold out. Merchant states free US shipping.

pieces.name: Burnt-orange fabric for suit panels
queries: burnt orange cotton fabric by the yard
pieces.styleNotes: Cut and sew burnt-orange shoulder, arm, side and knee panels onto the light jumpsuit base. This is required DIY construction; none of the jumpsuits includes these panels. Fabric alone does not create padded channels.

matches.reason: Price is for one yard of 44-inch-wide 100% cotton fabric, not a finished costume panel. Current primary page lists 7.5 yards in stock.
